Yaa foom Nabiyaama, zoe Wẽnd lɑ f rɑ tũ kɩfr-rãmbã la munaafɩgsã ye, ad Wẽnd yɩɩme n yaa Mit n yaa Bʋʋd-Mita.
Lɑ f pʋg b sẽn tɑɑsd foo sẽn yɑɑ sẽn yit f Soɑbã nengẽ wã, ad Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ kiba-Mit ne yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.
Lɑ f bobl f meng ne Wẽnde, lɑ lalld tɑ tεk ne Wẽnde.

Wẽnd kɑ ning sũy ɑ yiib rɑo bɑɑ a yembr pʋgẽ ye, lɑ A kɑ mɑɑn yãmb pɑgb nins yãmb sẽn yet tɩ b poayã yɑɑ wɑla y mɑ-rãmb poayã tɩ yɑɑ yãmb mɑ-rãmb ye, lɑ A kɑ mɑɑn yãmb kom-yõgdsã (koɑm-wubdsã) tɩ b yɑɑ yãmb koɑmb ye, yɑɑ yãmb noy goɑm lɑ rẽ, lɑ Wẽnd yetɑ sɩdɑ, lɑ Yẽ me n le wilgd sore.

Bool-y-b n tõk ne b bɑɑbã-rãmbã yʋy, rẽ n yɩɩd tɩrg Wẽnd nengẽ, lɑ yãmb sã n kɑ bãng b bɑɑbã-rãmbã rẽnd b yaa yãmb saam-biisi dĩinã pʋgẽ lɑ yãmb lalldba, lɑ yell kɑ be ne yãmb tɩ y sã n tudg n bool-b n tõk ne zẽng sẽn kɑ b bɑɑbã-rãmbã ye, lɑ yell sẽn be yɑɑ yãmb sẽn mɑɑn pʋ-toog y sũyã pʋsẽ wã, lɑ Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ Lutɑ lɑ Yoɑlsdɑ.

Nabiyaamã n sõmb ne sɩd-kõtbã n yɩɩd b mensã, lɑ ɑ pɑgbã yɑɑ b mɑ-rãmbɑ, lɑ roɑgdbã n sõmb ne tɑɑb n yɩɩdɑ, woto yaa Wẽnd Sebrã (Gafã) pʋgɑ, n yɩɩd sɩd-kõtbã lɑ sẽn yik-b n kẽng Mɑdiinã, sã n kɑ mikɑme tɩ y rɑt n mɑɑnɑ y lalldbã neere; wãndã yɩɩme n yɑɑ sẽn dɑ gʋls tɩ be sebrã pʋgẽ.

Lɑ tẽeg wakat ning Tõnd sẽn wɑ n deeg Nabiiyaam-rãmbã pʋlengã la D reeg fo pʋlengã lɑ ɑ Nuuh lɑ ɑ Ibrɑɑhɩɩm lɑ ɑ Musɑ lɑ ɑ Mɑryɑm biig ɑ Iisɑ me nengẽ, lɑ D reeg pʋleng kẽeng b nengẽ, tɩ b pids tẽn-tʋʋmdlemã.
Bʋɩl yĩng lɑ A sok sɩdã rãmb b sɩdã yelle, lɑ ɑ segl naon-zɑbdg kɩfr-rãmbã yĩngɑ.
Yaa yãmb neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdɑ! Tẽeg-y Wẽnd neemã wã yãmb zugu, zɑb-zɑbdb sẽn wɑ n nɑ n seg yãmb tɩ Tõnd tʋm sebg lɑ zɑb-zɑbdb yãmb sẽn kɑ ne-b ye, lɑ Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ Net ne yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.
B sẽn wɑ n yi yãmb yĩngr lɑ yãmb tẽngr wεεngẽ n wɑt yãmbɑ, lɑ sɑsɑ ning nin sẽn wɑ n nodg tɩ sũyã be ragsendakẽ, tɩ yãmb sãmbd Wẽnd ne sãmbse.
Beenẽ lɑ b zɑrb sɩd-kõtbã n ges lɑ b miim-b miuun-kεgengɑ.
Lɑ sɑsɑ ning munaafɩgsã lɑ neb nins bãas sẽn be b sũyẽ wã sẽn wɑ n yetẽ: "Wẽnd kɑ pʋlem tõnd rẽndɑ belgr bɑlɑ".

Lɑ sɑsɑ ning b sãndɑ sẽn wɑ n yeele: "yaa yãmb Yɑṯrib (Mɑdĩin) rãmbɑ yɑlsg zĩig kɑe y yĩng dε! Pĩnd n lebg-y"; tɩ b sãndɑ kot Nabiyaamã sor n yetẽ: "ɑd tõnd zɑgsã kɑ tɑr gũudb ye". Lɑ b zɑgsã yɑool n tɑr gũudba, kɑ baa fʋɩ n zʋʋg zoees bɑl lɑ b rɑt ye.
Lɑ tɩ b (bɛɛbã) sã n da tõe n tũ (tẽngã) kɩrems n kẽ, rẽ poorẽ tɩ b yeel-b tɩ b mɑɑn lɑgem-n-tɑɑre, b ra nɑ mɑɑn-ɑ, tɩ rẽnda meng yaa yol-yol ne-ba.
Lɑ b yɑool n dɑ pʋlmɑ Wẽnd pĩnda, tɩ b kɑ nɑ n zoe ye, lɑ Wẽnd pʋlengã yɑɑ bũmb ning b sẽn nɑ n soke.
Yeele: "zoees kɑ nɑ n tɑll yõod ne yãmb bɑɑ tɩ yãmb sã n zoe n nɑ n põs kũumã mɑɑ kʋʋbã ye, lɑ bɑɑ tɩ y põs me, y kõon n vɩɩm noog rẽndɑ bilf bɑlɑ''.
Yeele: "ãnd n tõe n põsg yãmb n yi Wẽnd t'A sã n dɑt yãmb ne wẽng maa t'A sã n rɑt yãmb ne yolsgo?" Lɑ b kɑ nɑ n pɑɑm lɑlld lɑ sõɑngd tɩ kɑ Wẽnd ye.
Ad Wẽnd mii koɑmesdbã sẽn be yãmb pʋgẽ wã lɑ neb nins sẽn yet b sɑɑm-biisã: "wa-y tõnd nengẽ wã". Lɑ b yɑool n kɑ sɑk n nɑ n kẽ keelmã (zɑbrã) pʋgẽ rẽndɑ bilf bɑlɑ.

B sẽn maan beem yãmb zug yĩnga, lɑ rɑbeemã sã n wɑ fo neeme tɩ b get foo tɩ b ninã yilimd wɑlɑ kũum sẽn yilimd ɑ soabɑ, lɑ rɑbeemã sã n looge b sɩlgdɑ yãmb ne zɩlm-noodo, n mɑɑn yã-beed n rɑt sõmbã (arzεgsã b sẽn pɑɑm bεεbẽ wã), bãmb lɑ sẽn kɑ kõ sɩd tɩ Wẽnd sãɑm b tʋʋmã, lɑ wãndã yɩɩme n yɑɑ nɑɑnɑ ne Wẽnde.

B sãmbdɑme tɩ zãmã wã nɑ n kɑ loog ye, lɑ zãmã wã sã n lebg n wɑ, b mɑɑndɑ nonglem n dɑg n beẽ weoogẽ dãmbã pʋgẽ n sokd yãmb yelle, lɑ bɑɑ tɩ b sã n dɑ pɑ yãmb pʋgẽ wã me, b kɑ nɑ n kẽ zɑbrẽ wã rẽndɑ bilf bɑlɑ.
Sɩd la hakɩɩka, ad togs-n-tɑ-sõng zĩndɑ Wẽnd Tẽn-tʋʋmã vɩɩmã pʋgẽ yãmb yĩngɑ, ned ning sẽn tẽedɑ Wẽnd lɑ Yɑoolem dɑɑrã lɑ ɑ tẽeg Wẽnd yell wʋsgo.
Lɑ sɩd-kõɑtbã sẽn wɑ n yã zãmã wã, b yeelɑme: "yɑɑ wã lɑ Wẽnd ne A Tẽn-tʋʋmã sẽn pʋlem tõndã, lɑ Wẽnd la A Tẽn-tʋʋmã pʋlengã yɩɩ sɩdɑ". Lɑ rẽ kɑ pɑɑs-b rẽndɑ sɩd-kũun lɑ sɑk-n-tũ.
Neb n zĩnd sɩd-kõtbã pʋgẽ n pids b sẽn pʋlengã ne Wẽndã, lɑ be b pʋgẽ sẽn mɑɑn kɑɑlem, lɑ be b pʋgẽ sẽn nɑ gũudɑ, lɑ b kɑ tol n teem bɑɑ bilf ye.
Bʋɩl yĩng tɩ Wẽnd rol sɩdã rãmb b sɩdã yĩngɑ, lɑ A nɑms munaafɩgsã t'A sã n dɑtɑ, mɑɑ t'A sɑk n deeg b tuubgã, ad Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ Yaafd lɑ Yoɑlsdɑ.
Lɑ Wẽnd lebsɑ kɩfr-rãmbã ne b sũ-yikrã, b kɑ pɑɑm bɑɑ fʋɩ, lɑ Wẽnd sekɑ sɩd-kõɑtbã n yi zɑbrã, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ pang Soɑb lɑ zɩslem Soɑbɑ.
Lɑ A sik Yahuud-rãmb nins sẽn sõng kɩfr-rãmbã b gũudmã zɑgs pʋsẽ, lɑ A kẽes b sũyẽ wã rɑbeem, tɩ yãmb kʋʋd b sãndɑ lɑ y yõgd b sãndɑ.
Lɑ A leds yãmb b tẽngẽ wã lɑ b zɑgsẽ wã lɑ b ɑrzεgsẽ wã. La yãmb nao sẽn nɑ n kɑ tɑg tẽng ningã, lɑ Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ bũmb fãɑ Tõogdɑ.
Yaa foom Nabiyaama! Yeel f pɑgbã: "Sã n mikɑme tɩ yãmb rɑtɑ dũni vɩɩmã lɑ ɑ nɑg-teedã, bɩ y wɑ tɩ m kõ-y kũun tɩ tɑ y yɑm lɑ m bɑs-y bɑsg sẽn be neere,
Lɑ sã n mikɑme tɩ yãmb rɑtɑ Wẽnd lɑ A Tẽn-tʋʋmã lɑ yɑoolem zɑkã bɩ y bãng tɩ Wẽnd seglɑ rol-kẽeng n bĩng sẽn yɑɑ b mɑnegdb yãmb pʋgẽ wã".
Yaa yãmb Nabiyaam pagba! Ned ningɑ sẽn wa ne yel-wẽnd vẽenegɑ b fãoodɑ naongã naoor ɑ yiib ɑ yĩngɑ, lɑ rẽ me yɩɩme n yɑɑ nɑɑnɑ ne Wẽnde.
Lɑ yãmb pʋgẽ wã ned ning sẽn wõr ɑ meng lɑ ɑ tʋm tʋʋm-sõmɑ, D kõt-ɑ-lɑ ɑ rolbã noor ɑ yiibu, lɑ D segl rɩtl wɑgell ɑ yĩngɑ.
Yaa yãmb Nabiyaam pagbã! Ad yãmb kɑ wɑla pɑg buudã fãɑ dε! Ad yãmb sã n zoe Wẽnde, bɩ y rɑ noos y koees tɩ ned ning bãɑg sẽn be ɑ sũurẽ wɑ mɑɑn yɑmleoog ye, lɑ y gom mɑnegr goɑm sẽn pɑ tɑr sik ye.

Lɑ y tɑbend y zɑgsã pʋse, lɑ y rɑ yi wɑlɑ rẽenem zɩɩlem yiibã buud ye, lɑ y yɑls ne Pʋʋsg lɑ y kõ ɑrzεk-yɩlgr-pʋɩɩrã (Zɑkã), lɑ y tũ Wẽnd lɑ A Tẽn-tʋʋmã, Wẽnd sẽn dɑtã yɑɑ sẽn nɑ loog ne rẽok buud fãɑ n bɑs yãmb ɑ zɑkã rãmbɑ lɑ ɑ yɩlg yãmb sõmɑ.
Lɑ y tẽeg Wẽnd goamã la Bʋʋd-welgr (bãngre) sẽn kɑremd yãmb zɑgsã pʋsẽ wã, ad Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ Bʋg-bʋg Soɑb ne yãmbɑ n yɑɑ kiba-Mita.

Ad lɩslaam rɑɑdã lɑ lɩslaam pogsã, lɑ sɩd-kõɑtb rɑɑdã lɑ sɩd-kõɑtb pogsã, lɑ wõr-m-meng rɑɑdã lɑ wõr-m-meng pogsã, lɑ sɩd-toagsdb rɑɑdã lɑ sɩd-toagsdb pogsã, lɑ sug-maandb rɑɑdã lɑ sug-maandb pogsã, lɑ (Wẽnd) yεεsdb raadã lɑ (Wẽnd) yεεsdb pogsã, lɑ sãrã-mɑɑndb rɑɑdã lɑ sãrã-mɑɑndb pogsã, lɑ no-loεtb rɑɑdã lɑ no-loεtb pogsã, lɑ gũus-m-tɑoor raadã lɑ gũus-m-tɑoor pogsã, lɑ (Wẽnd) tẽegdb rɑɑdã wʋsgã lɑ (Wẽnd) tẽegdb pogsã, ɑd Wẽnd seglɑ yaafg lɑ rolb sẽn yɑɑ kẽeng b yĩngɑ.

Lɑ kɑ segd ne sɩd-kõɑt rɑoog lɑ sɩd-kõɑt poɑk tɩ Wẽnd lɑ A Tẽn-tʋʋmã sã n gãneg yell bʋʋd n sε bɩ b le tɑll yɑm-yãkr b yellã pʋgẽ ye, lɑ ned ning sẽn kɩɩsɑ Wẽnd lɑ A Tẽn-tʋʋmã rẽnd ɑ menemɑ meneng sẽn yɑɑ vẽenegɑ.

(Lɑ tẽeg sɑsɑ ning) fo sẽn wɑ n yet fo sẽn mɑɑn ɑ soɑb neer tɩ Wẽnd mɑɑn-ɑ neerã: "tɑll f pɑgã lɑ f zoe Wẽnde". Lɑ fo solgd f mengẽ wã yell ningɑ Wẽnd sẽn nɑ n vẽneg-ɑ, lɑ fo zoet nebã, lɑ yɑool n yɑɑ Wẽnd lɑ fo sõmb n zoe. Lɑ a Zɑyd sẽn wɑ n bɑs pɑgã, Tõnd kẽes-ɑ-lɑ kãɑdem pʋgẽ (Tõnd loe-ɑ-lɑ fur) n kõ foo, bʋɩl yĩng tɩ yell rɑ zĩnd sɩd-kõɑtbã yĩng b kom-yõgdsã pɑgbã pʋgẽ, tɩ b sã n bɑs-bɑ tɩ bãmb wẽneg n nɑ n fur-bɑ, lɑ Wẽnd yel-rɑtmã yɑɑ bũmb sẽn yɩt tɩlɑe.
Yell kɑ be ne Nabiyaamã, Wẽnd sẽn kõ-a sor yell ning pʋgẽ ye; yɑɑ Wẽnd yell sẽn dɑ sɩng n beẽ sẽn loog-b pĩndã zugu, lɑ Wẽnd yellã yɑɑ sẽn korde tɩ nɑ n yɩ tɩlɑe.
Tẽn-tʋʋm-kãensã tɑɑsdɑ Wẽnd tẽn-tʋmdã lɑ b zoet-A lɑ b kɑ zoet ned baa ɑ ye sã n kɑ Wẽnde, lɑ Wẽnd Geelgã A yembsã tʋʋmã sek yã.
A Mʋhɑmmɑd kɑ yɩ n yɑɑ yãmb roɑpã baa a yembr bɑɑbɑ ye, lɑ sẽn be bɑlɑ, a yɑɑ Wẽnd Tẽn-tʋʋm n yɑɑ Nabiyaam-rãmbɑ pidsdɑ, lɑ Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ Mit ne bũmb fãɑ.
Yãmb ɑ sẽn kõ-b sɩdɑ! Tẽeg-y Wẽnde (yʋʋrã/yelle), tẽegr sẽn wɑooge.
Lɑ y yɩlg-A yibeoog lɑ zɑɑbre.
Yẽndɑ n yolsd yãmbɑ lɑ A pẽgd-yã, t'A Mɑlεgsɑ me kot Wẽnd n kõt yãmbɑ sẽn nɑ yɩl t'A yiis yãmb ligsẽ wã n kẽng vẽenemẽ wã, lɑ A yɩɩme n yɑɑ Yoɑlsdɑ ne sɩd-kõɑtbã.
B sẽn nɑ n sεg-A rɑɑrã b pʋʋsem yɑɑ Tɩlgre, lɑ A segla rol-wɑgell b yĩngɑ.
Foom ɑ Tẽn-tʋʋma! Ad Tõnd tʋma foom tɩ fo yɑɑ kaset soɑbɑ lɑ sũ-noogdɑ lɑ bugsdɑ,
Lɑ boɑɑnd n tʋgd Wẽnd nengẽ ne A rɑɑbo, lɑ fɩtl sẽn yɑɑ vẽenem.
Lɑ f noog sɩd-kõɑtbã sũuri tɩ yɩɩdlem kẽeng sẽn yi Wẽnd nengẽ be b yĩngɑ.
Lɑ f rɑ tũ kɩfr-rãmbã la munaafɩgsã ye, lɑ f rɑ wẽnemd n ges b sẽn nɑmsd foo wã ye, lɑ f bobl f meng ne Wẽnde, lɑ ɑd Bobend tɑ tεk tɩ sã n yɑɑ Wẽnde.

Yãmb ɑ sẽn kõ-b sɩdɑ! Y sã n kẽ kãadem ne sɩd-kõt-pogsã rẽ poorẽ n bɑs-bɑ tɑoor tɩ yãmb nɑ n kɑ kẽ ne-bɑ, bɩ y bãng tɩ b ka tɑr rɑsem-rãmb sõore b sẽn nɑ n zĩnd n gũ ye; bɩ y kõ-b kũun tɩ tɑ b yɑm, lɑ y bɑs-b bɑsg sẽn be neere.

Foom a Nabiyaama! Ad Tõnd kõo foo sor ne fo pɑgb nins fo sẽn kõ-b b furã ligdi, lɑ D le kõ-f sor tɩ f tõe n kẽ kãɑdem ne fo nug sẽn sooge (yem-pogsã) sẽn yɑɑ Wẽnd sẽn n kõ foomã, lɑ f bɑɑbɑ kãseng lɑ f bɑɑbɑ bil kom-pugli, lɑ f pʋgdb-rãmb kom-pugli, lɑ f yεsb kom-pugli, lɑ f mɑ tão-pogs kom-pugli nins b sẽn maan higra n nɑɑg foomã (n yik n wãag n bɑs b tẽngã), lɑ pɑg sẽn yɑɑ sɩd-kõɑt sẽn dɩkɑ meng n kõ Nabiyaam tɩ Nabiyaamã sã n dɑt n kẽe kãɑdem ne-ɑ sɑkdɑme t'ɑ loe-ɑ furi, lɑ rẽ welgɑ ne foo f yembr bɑlɑ, sɩd-kõt-rɑɑd ɑ tɑɑbã (Mũumin-dãmbɑ) kɑ nɑɑg be ye, Tõnd bãngɑ Tõnd sẽn dogl-b yεl nins b pɑgbẽ wã (pɑ tõe n zʋʋg nɑɑs ye) lɑ b nusã sẽn so pɑgb ninsã yεlã pʋgẽ, Tõnd mɑɑnɑ woto bʋɩl yĩng lɑ weoogr rɑ pɑɑm foo ye, ad Wẽnd yɩɩme n yaa Yaafd n yaa Yolsda.

Fo tõe n lɑk n bɑsɑ f sẽn dɑt ɑ soɑb f pɑgbã pʋga, lɑ f pẽnegd f sẽn dɑt ɑ soɑbɑ; lɑ fo sẽn dɑt n pẽneg ɑ soɑb fo sẽn dɑ lɑk n bɑs-b rãmbã pʋgẽ wã yell kɑ ne f ye; rẽndɑ n pẽ ne b nin nɑ mɑɑg lɑ b sũy kõn n sãame, la b yar ne fo sẽn kõ-b yem kãm fãɑ bũmb ning me le tɑ b yɑm; lɑ Wẽnd mii sẽn be yãmb sũyã pʋsẽ, lɑ Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ Bãngd n yɑɑ bʋg-bʋg Soɑbɑ.
Pɑgb ɑ tɑɑb kɑ segd ne foo bãmbã loogr poor ye, lɑ f leb n kɑ tõe n tedg-b ne pɑgb ɑ tɑɑb me bɑɑ tɩ b sõmblemã taa fo yɑm, sɑ n kɑ fo nug sẽn sooge (yem-pogsã), lɑ Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ bũmb fãɑ Gũusdɑ.

Yãmb ɑ neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdɑ! Rɑ kẽ-y Nabiyaamã zɑgsẽ wã sã n kɑ b kõo yãmb sor tɩ y kẽ n rɩ ye, lɑ y rɑ wɑ zĩnd n gũud-ɑ ye, lɑ b sã n bool-y bɩ y kẽ, lɑ y sã n dɩ n sε bɩ y sãeeg lɑ y rɑ yɑɑs n sõs n lolem yɑm ye, ɑd rẽ rɑ nɑmsdɑ Nabiyaamã t'ɑ yɑool n zoet yãnd ne yãmbɑ, lɑ Wẽnd kɑ zoet yãnd ne sɩd vẽnegr ye, lɑ yãmb sã n dɑt n sok Nɑbiyɑɑmɑ pɑgbã bũmb yelle, bɩ y sok-b lill poore, rẽnd n yɩɩd yɩlgr yãmb ne bãmb sũyẽ wã, lɑ kɑ segd ne yãmb tɩ y mɑɑn sẽn nɑ nɑms Wẽnd Tẽn-tʋʋmã ye, lɑ kɑ segd ne-y me tɩ y kẽ kãadem ne ɑ pɑgbã ɑ loogr poor ye, ɑd rẽndɑ yɩɩme n yɑɑ zũnuub kẽeng Wẽnd nengẽ.
Yãmb sɑ n vẽneg bũmb bɩ y soɑlg-ɑ lɑme, ad Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ bũmb fãɑ Mitɑ.

Yell kɑ be ne pɑgbã tɩ b ra lud n yi rapã, tɩ sã n yɑɑ b bɑɑbɑ-rãmbã, lɑ b koɑmbã, lɑ b tãopã, lɑ b tãopã koɑmbã, lɑ b tão-pogsã koɑmbã, lɑ b pʋg-tɑɑsã, lɑ b nusã sẽn soogã (b yembsã), lɑ y zoe Wẽnde, bɑlɑ Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ bũmbɑ fãɑ Sεεta.
Ad Wẽnd ne A Malεgsã pʋʋsda Nabiyaamã, yãmb ɑ neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdɑ! Pʋʋs-y-yã-a lɑ y kos tɩlgr sẽn yɑɑ kẽoong n kõ-a.
Ad sẽn mɑɑnd-b tɩ nɑmsd Wẽnd la A Tẽn-tʋʋmã, Wẽnd kãɑbd-b lɑme Dũni kaanẽ la Laahre, lɑ A segl naon-fɑɑgdg b yĩngɑ.
Lɑ neb nins sẽn nɑmsd-b muumin rɑɑdã lɑ muumin pogsã tɩ b yaool n ka maan baa fʋɩ wã, ad b tʋkɑ zĩri lɑ yel-wẽnd sẽn yɑɑ vẽenegɑ.

Yaa foom Nabiyaama! Yeel f pɑgbã lɑ f kom-pugli wã lɑ muumin-rãmbã pɑgbã, tɩ b woglg b fʋ-bεdã n mɑɑn tɩ kɩll n pẽnege, tɩ rẽnd n pẽ ne b nɑ bãng-ba, n kɑ mɑɑn tɩ naong tɑ-b ye, lɑ Wẽnd yɩɩme n yaa Yaafd n yaa Yolsdɑ.
Lɑ tɩ munaafɩgsã la bãag sẽn be neb nins sũyẽ wã la zũngdbã sẽn be Madiinã sã n kɑ tek n bɑse, D nɑ n kɩtame tɩ fo zab ne-ba, rẽ poorẽ, b kõn n zĩnd ne foo Mɑdĩinɑ rẽndɑ sɑsɑ bilf bɑlɑ.
Tɩ b yɑɑ b sẽn digd-b rãmb n zãɑg ne yolsgo, b sẽn be zĩig ning fãɑ, b yõgd-b lɑme n kʋʋd sõmɑ.
Yɑɑ Wẽnd sẽn maan tɩ deng tɑoorã to-to wã, lɑ fo kɑ nɑ n pɑɑm Wẽnd mɑnesmã toeeng ye.
Nebã sokdɑ foom Sɑsã wã yelle (Dũnĩ wã Yikrã), yeele: ''Ad a bãngrã yɑɑ Wẽnd nengẽ bɑl lɑ be, lɑ ãndã n wĩnigd foom tɩ Sɑsã wã kɑ pẽnege?''
Ad Wẽnd kãaba kɩfr-rãmbã lɑ A seglg Bugum b yĩngɑ.
B yɑɑ ɑ pʋgẽ wã pɑɑdbɑ, lɑ b kɑ nɑ n tol n pɑɑm lɑlld lɑ sõngd ye.
Raɑr ning b sẽn nɑ n leebd b nemsã Bugmẽ wã tɩ b yetẽ: "Kato, tõnd sã n dɑ tũẽ Wẽnd la A Tẽn-tʋʋmã pɑ são".
Tɩ b yetẽ: "d Soɑbɑ! Ad tõnd tũu d zu-soab-dãmbã lɑ d nin-bεdã tɩ b menes tõnd sorã,
D Soɑbɑ! Kõ-b naong sẽn fãoog n pɑɑse, lɑ F kãɑb-b kãab-bedre".
Yaa yãmb neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdɑ! Rɑ yɩ-y wala neb nins sẽn nɑms ɑ Musɑ wã ye, tɩ Wẽnd tɩlg-ɑ n yi b sẽn dõd-ɑ wã. Lɑ ɑ yɩɩme n yɑɑ wɑgell Wẽnd nengẽ.
Yaa yãmb neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdɑ! Zoe-y Wẽnd lɑ y yeel gom-tɩrse.
T'A nɑ mɑneg yãmb tʋʋmã, lɑ A yaaf yãmb yel-wẽnɑ, la ned ning sẽn tũ Wẽnd lɑ A Tẽn-tʋʋmã, sɩd la hakɩɩka a tɩlgɑ tɩlg-kẽengɑ.
Ad Tõnd yeela sɑɑsã lɑ Tẽngã lɑ tãmsã tɩ b reeg Bobelle, tɩ b zãgs-a la b yet tɩ yɩɩdɑ b pãnga, b kɑ nɑ n tõog ye; tɩ ninsɑɑl tʋk-a, ad ɑ yɩɩ wẽgd ne a mengã n yɑɑ zɩta.
Bʋɩl yĩng lɑ A nɑms munaafɩgsã la munaafɩg-pogsã la lagem-n-ta-rapã la lagem-ta-pogsã, la Wẽnd sɑk n deeg sɩd-kõt-rɑɑdã lɑ sɩd-kõt-pogsã tuubgu. Lɑ Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑa Yaafda n yɑɑ Yolsdɑ.
